claim: across the 316 committed mixed-boolean-arithmetic cases, every answer disrobe returns agrees with the held-out original, and a case whose simplification exceeds a 2 second per-entry budget is named as a refusal rather than counted either way. The reference run recorded 254 answers and 62 refusals.
detail: 316 entries, each an obfuscated expression whose original is held in a separate file the recovery path never opens: 216 from a forward rewriter written from the published identity tables, at widths 2 through 64 over 1 to 8 variables, and 100 from MBA-Obfuscator run over kernels this repository chose. The count is the population, not a recovery rate. Measured alongside it on this box: 254 of the 316 entries returned an answer inside a 2 second per-entry budget and 0 of those answers disagreed with the held-out original; the other 62 refused the budget and are reported as refusals rather than counted either way. A seeded-wrong recovery that returns one more than the truth is rejected on all 254, and one that swaps addition for exclusive-or is rejected on 252, the 2 survivors being cases where the substitution happens to preserve the value.
gate_source: evidence/corpus/mba/cases.jsonl, regenerated byte-identically by the corpus generator's generate command and gated by cargo test -p disrobe-mba --test evidence_corpus_gate
measured: 316 corpus entries with a held-out original

oracle.external: the originals are held out of the input the pass receives. 100 of the 316 cases were produced by MBA-Obfuscator (ICICS 2021, MIT, pinned at commit 8574ef8) run over integer kernels this repository chose, so their obfuscated form is third-party and the original is the pre-transform kernel. The other 216 come from a forward rewriter under evidence/generators/mba that links no disrobe crate at all, which the workspace health check proves over the resolved dependency graph. Grading is a behavioural differential against check vectors the generator computed with its own evaluator, so a wrong answer cannot agree with a value the recovery path produced.
oracle.note: The tier is coverage-self-reported because the published number is a population count, not a correctness rate. What the corpus does establish is that the grading is not vacuous: a seeded-wrong recovery returning one more than the truth is rejected on all 254 graded entries, and one that swaps addition for exclusive-or is rejected on 252, the 2 survivors being expressions where the substitution happens to preserve the value. The 62 budget refusals are concentrated in 64-bit polynomial and non-polynomial output from the external obfuscator and in multiplication kernels; they are a measured ceiling of the current simplifier under a 2 second budget, reported by name, and not a failure of the corpus. A second lane over published datasets that ship their originals (MBA-Blast, MBA-Solver, Loki) is fetched at a pinned sha256 rather than committed, because none of them carries a licence this repository may redistribute; it graded 1470 of 1572 entries with 0 disagreements locally and is reported as a local figure, never a continuous-integration one.

title: Mixed-boolean-arithmetic recovery graded against originals the recovery path never reads
